neighbours.label: a word expressing that something is certain or confirmed, across languages (確認, 확실, 确实, firmly, certainly)
fire: The mayor firmly insisted that the money had been spent.
He will certainly arrive before the end of the meeting.
この予定を確認してから連絡します。
这个消息确实让大家很高兴。
She firmly believes that the law is unjust.
添付の書類を確認してください。
quiet: The mayor quietly mentioned that the money had been spent.
He will probably arrive before the end of the meeting.
この予定を変更してから連絡します。
这个消息让大家很高兴。
She sometimes says that the law is old.
添付の書類を印刷してください。

notes: Card: '確' x9, ' 확' x6, '确' x2, ' firmly' x2, ' assert' x2, ' certainly'. A concept across languages. Probes: ' firmly' 0.601, '確認' 0.404, '확' 0.345, ' certainly' 0.238, '确实' 0.210; 'loudly said' 0.036, 'read this message' 0.027. Near misses keep the frames with no certainty word.
